title: Echoed Dreams

outfit_card.silhouette: Rococo-inspired grand ballgown featuring an architectural fitted corset bodice, wide pannier skirt silhouette, tiered lace ruffles, structured standing collar, and cascading voluminous draping.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Gilded architectural birdcage crown adorned with glowing spires, yellow and turquoise silk roses, delicate beaded circlets, and a sweeping tall white plume feather.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Fitted seafoam satin bodice with ornate gilded stomacher embroidery, scalloped standing fan collar of Chantilly lace, emerald drop jewels, and elbow-length pagoda sleeves ending in triple-tiered lace engageantes.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Voluminous mint-green pannier overskirt draped with emerald jewel swags, opening over ivory pleated tulle underskirts, finished with golden ribbon rosettes, baroque hem embroidery, and concealed ornate court slippers.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Ornate gilded birdcage motifs, draped bead festoons, baroque filigree scrollwork, pastel floral accents, and floating musical score ribbons.
